_comment: Conformance vectors for the table parser.
BOTH implementations must pass: src/macsmith/table.py and web/js/table.js.
This closes the same drift gap mac_vectors.json closes for the MAC core -
the two table parsers were previously ported by hand with nothing holding
Run: pytest tests/test_table_vectors.py  and  node web/js/conformance.mjs

cases.name: cisco mac address-table with banner and footer
cases.text:
Mac Address Table
-------------------------------------------

Vlan    Mac Address       Type        Ports
----    -----------       --------    -----
 All    0100.0ccc.cccc    STATIC      CPU
   1    0000.0c07.ac01    DYNAMIC     Gi1/0/1
   1    001a.2b3c.4d5e    DYNAMIC     Gi1/0/2
Total Mac Addresses for this criterion: 3
cases.why: the centered banner must lose to the real header, and the Total footer is not data

cases.name: cisco show ip arp with unresolved entries
cases.text:
Protocol  Address          Age (min)  Hardware Addr   Type   Interface
Internet  10.1.1.1               12   0000.0c07.ac01  ARPA   Vlan1
Internet  10.1.1.2                -   INCOMPLETE      ARPA   Vlan1
Internet  10.1.1.3               44   001a.2b3c.4d5e  ARPA   Vlan1
Internet  10.1.1.4                -   INCOMPLETE      ARPA   Vlan1
cases.why: INCOMPLETE must not dilute the MAC column below the confidence threshold

cases.name: linux arp with a single-nibble octet
cases.text:
Address                  HWtype  HWaddress           Flags Mask            Iface
10.0.0.1                 ether   fe:35:b6:60:0f:ee   C                     eth0
10.0.0.2                 ether   00:1a:2b:3c:4d:5e   C                     eth0

cases.name: windows line endings from a terminal paste
cases.text:
Vlan    Mac Address       Type        Ports
   1    0000.0c07.ac01    DYNAMIC     Gi1/0/1
   1    001a.2b3c.4d5e    DYNAMIC     Gi1/0/2
cases.why: a stray carriage return would corrupt the last cell of every row

cases.name: tab separated, as pasted from a spreadsheet
cases.text:
Vlan	MacAddress	Type	Ports
1	0000.0c07.ac01	DYNAMIC	Gi1/0/1
1	001a.2b3c.4d5e	DYNAMIC	Gi1/0/2
cases.why: a single-word header lines up with the data, so it is safe to emit

cases.name: ragged rows, blank lines, and a lone token
cases.text:
1 0000.0c07.ac01 Gi1/0/1
2 001a.2b3c.4d5e
3
   
4 0242.ac11.0002 Gi1/0/4 extra trailing columns here
cases.why: short rows must never raise; the original scripts IndexErrored here

cases.name: every entry unresolved
cases.text:
Protocol  Address          Age (min)  Hardware Addr   Type   Interface
Internet  10.1.1.2                -   INCOMPLETE      ARPA   Vlan1
Internet  10.1.1.4                -   INCOMPLETE      ARPA   Vlan1
cases.why: with no resolved address there is no MAC column to find, and claiming one would be worse

Vlan    Mac Address       Type        Ports

cases.text:
